categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of connectors, ultra-fine coaxial cable assemblies, high-speed transmission cable assemblies, wireless communication RF connector cable assemblies, metal stamping parts, and various electronic components. Its products serve diverse industries including notebook computers and peripherals, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, cloud servers, network communications, industrial equipment, and medical applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced connector technologies such as fine pitch, low profile, high frequency, and high power connectors. It integrates stamping, injection molding, assembly, mechanical design, and electrical analysis for product development. The manufacturing process includes in-house mold design and production, automated assembly equipment development, and stringent quality control systems including ISO 9001, QC080000, and IATF16949 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the notebook computer, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, cloud server, network communication, industrial equipment, and medical sectors. The company serves major international clients, including global Tier 1 automotive suppliers and large-scale cloud and network infrastructure providers, with a focus on delivering customized connector and cable solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production facilities in Taiwan, China (Kunshan, Dongguan, Zhuhai), the Philippines, and Vietnam. Sales and marketing offices cover major markets including the United States, Japan, Germany, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Singapore. The company targets growth in overseas markets and mainland China, leveraging regional supply chain localization trends.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of connectors and cable assemblies. It controls key upstream processes such as mold and tooling development and downstream integration services including product assembly and testing, positioning itself as a preferred supplier to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-frequency, high-speed, and high-power connector technologies, expanding automotive electronics and cloud server product lines, and enhancing customization capabilities. The company invests heavily in R&D to shorten development cycles and improve product performance, with ongoing projects in PCIe Gen6/7 connectors, high-power Type C connectors, and next-generation high-speed cable assemblies. It also emphasizes automation and vertical integration in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of connectors, cable assemblies, metal stamping parts, and related electronic components. The company also earns licensing fees from technology transfers to subsidiaries. Sales are made to a diversified customer base globally, with no significant reliance on a single customer, and revenue growth is driven by expanding product lines and market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a global market dominated by major players such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol, Aptiv, and Molex. It holds an estimated market share of over 4% in Taiwan's connector industry and positions itself as a competitive supplier by focusing on rapid product development, cost control through regional manufacturing, and high-quality certifications. The company aims to differentiate through integrated solutions and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$9.77 billion, representing a 15.14% increase from the prior year. Net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$344 million, a significant turnaround from losses in the previous year. The company maintains a stable asset base of about NT$13.6 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes rapid product development and customization capabilities tailored to customer specifications, enabling it to meet diverse and evolving market demands. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering connectors, cable assemblies, and metal components, supported by strong quality management and vertical integration. Its global production footprint and technical expertise in high-frequency and high-power connectors provide competitive cost advantages and enhanced service responsiveness.
